title: Support Qwen-VL GGUF export (torch>=2.6 requirement)
description: Qwen/Qwen-VL weights are stored as .bin; transformers >=4.57 enforces torch>=2.6 for torch.load due to CVE-2025-32434. Current modal gguf image uses torch 2.5.1+cu121, so GGUF export aborts. Need solution: upgrade modal image stack to torch>=2.6 (with matching torchvision/torchaudio), or locate/publish safetensors weights for Qwen-VL.
